name: Переслідування та зв’язка
description:
In this lesson we are going to prepare a pin by chasing an enemy piece to an unfavorable spot.

See example 1. By capturing the rook first, black's king and bishop come into an unfortunate alignment. We can take advantage with a pin!

What do you have to do?

Chase an enemy piece to an unfavorable square and take advantage with a pin.

examples.text: By exchanging on b8, white chases the king to a square where it is on the same line (file) as the bishop: 1.Rxb8+! Kxb8. And now white has the chance to pin the bishop: 2.Rb1!

texts: Pin a piece with a forcing move.
